description: Economic calendar from official agency schedules only, no API key: US (BLS, BEA, Census, Federal Reserve FOMC), UK (ONS) and euro area (ECB). Exact release time in UTC and local time, importance, category and period for CPI, jobs report, GDP, PCE, retail sales, FOMC and ECB rate decisions. Upcoming, today, week, date range, next release per indicator, event list. Monitor mode returns only new or moved releases. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.02/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/economic-calendar-api.

agency.description: Only releases of this agency. Empty = all.

category.description: Only releases of this category. Empty = all.

country.description: Filter by country code: US, GB (UK) or EA (euro area). Empty = all.

days.description: For mode upcoming: how many days ahead (1-120).

from.description: For mode range: start date YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).

importance.description: high = market movers only (CPI, jobs report, GDP, PCE, retail sales, PPI, FOMC, ECB, UK CPI/labour/GDP). Empty = all.

mode.description: upcoming = releases from now for the next Days; today / week = this UTC day or ISO week; range = From..To (past dates allowed, max 370 days); next = the next release of each indicator matching Search (e.g. cpi, nonfarm, gdp, fomc); events =

search.description: Text in the indicator name, e.g. cpi, nonfarm, gdp, pce, retail sales, fomc, labour market. Required for mode next.

to.description: For mode range: end date YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Empty = From + 30 days.
